name: Circa Survive
label: Equal Vision Records
lede: Anthony Green walked out of Saosin because he was scared, built a band in Philadelphia around dreamy guitars and his impossible voice, and kept it going for eighteen years, through a major-label detour, a stay in a mental health facility and a relapse.

eras.title: Scared out of Saosin
eras.text: Anthony Green had become the voice of Saosin and then quit, in mid-February 2004, before the band's first album. He went home to the Philadelphia area and, with Equal Vision Records backing him, built a new band out of friends from the local post-hardcore circuit within months.

q: I was just scared. I was scared of committing.
years.src: Wikipedia: Circa Survive · Wikipedia: Anthony Green
years.h: Anthony Green quits Saosin
years.p: In mid-February 2004 Anthony Green, 21, walks away from Saosin. Cove Reber replaces him; Green would not sing with Saosin again until 2014.
years.xp: Green later explained the exit plainly: he wasn't ready to commit to Saosin. He went back to Philadelphia and called his friend Colin Frangicetto.

years.h: Circa Survive come together in Philadelphia
years.p: Green and guitarist Colin Frangicetto recruit Brendan Ekstrom from Frangicetto's old band [[This Day Forward|bcd7a1a3-ab7e-40cd-b604-d5197f3fc598]], bassist Nick Beard from Taken, and drummer Steve Clifford. The line-up is set by summer.
years.xp:
Equal Vision backed the new band from the start and helped with the recruiting. Ekstrom and Frangicetto had toured with Taken in their This Day Forward days, which is how they knew Beard.

Clifford came through Vadim Taver of Marigold. Frangicetto remembered that Clifford jammed with them for a week and that was it.

years.h: Circa Survive announce their debut album on MySpace
years.p: In November 2004 the band announces its first album on MySpace, and later posts the whole record there before it's in stores.

eras.title: Montauk and the Twilight Army
eras.text: Juturna took its cues from a novel and a Charlie Kaufman film and made Circa Survive a word-of-mouth band. Two years of touring with My Chemical Romance, Thrice and Coheed and Cambria set up On Letting Go, which went into the Billboard top 25.

years.h: Juturna, Circa Survive's debut on Equal Vision
years.p: Recorded with [[Brian McTernan|eda2cb2f-b2c6-4e74-9fd7-49ea52df4172]] at Salad Days in Beltsville, Maryland. Inspired by House of Leaves and Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind; it reaches No. 183 on the Billboard 200.
years.xp:
The closer, Meet Me in Montauk, is named for a line in Eternal Sunshine and runs nearly 15 minutes, with a hidden track called House of Leaves starting at 8:56.

The dual guitars were drenched in effects and the drums borrowed from jazz; AllMusic filed it under progressive hardcore.

years.h: Circa Survive tour with My Chemical Romance and Thrice
years.p: Within months of Juturna, Circa Survive are opening for My Chemical Romance and Thrice. A September tour with [[Motion City Soundtrack|190e78ac-8f44-4bf1-a4ff-95ed9376ad9e]] follows.

years.h: Anthony Green sings The Bamboozle in a dress
years.p: Anthony Green often wears dresses at outdoor festivals, notably The Bamboozle in New Jersey in 2006 and the 2007 Warped Tour.

years.h: The Twilight Army Tour, Circa Survive's first headliner
years.p: After a European run with Coheed and Cambria and Thrice, Circa Survive headline for the first time. That fall they tour with [[Thursday|0acae232-d31a-4211-b6d0-6af1b6350274]], [[Rise Against|606bf117-494f-4864-891f-09d63ff6aa4b]] and [[Billy Talent|fd429857-5ace-4609-ae54-1502c3bdac11]].

years.h: Circa Survive play Coachella
years.p: Circa Survive play the Coachella festival in Indio, California, in April 2007, then the whole summer's Warped Tour with Coheed and Cambria, [[The Used|8262d8e4-9137-4bb3-a787-3caabbbc13e9]] and [[Bad Religion|149e6720-4e4a-41a4-afca-6d29083fc091]].

years.h: On Letting Go debuts at No. 24
years.p: Circa Survive's second Equal Vision album sells 24,000 copies its first week and debuts at No. 24 on the Billboard 200. Esao Andrews paints the cover.
years.xp:
Brian McTernan produced again, with tighter guitars and drums and more bass in the mix. By July 11, 2007 it had sold 51,357 copies, per Wikipedia.

On the tour, the band projected a silent film behind them while they played.

years.h: Circa Survive open for Thirty Seconds to Mars at Brixton
years.p: Circa Survive open for [[Thirty Seconds to Mars|d8354b38-e942-4c89-ba93-29323432abc3]] at the Brixton Academy in London, and ring in 2008 with Thursday and [[The Gaslight Anthem|f208f09e-b5b3-4b06-87cd-f7230fae17e3]] at the Starland Ballroom in New Jersey.

eras.title: The Atlantic years
eras.text: Circa Survive signed to Atlantic Records and made their highest-charting album out of Anthony Green's stay in a mental health facility. It sold, but not enough for the major label.

years.h: A B-side to save Siren Records in Doylestown
years.p: Circa Survive release The Most Dangerous Commercials as a charity download to help Siren Records, the record store in Anthony Green's hometown of Doylestown, move. 1,000 Witnesses raised money for Invisible Children that spring.

years.h: Anthony Green releases his first solo album, Avalon
years.p: Green's solo debut Avalon comes out in 2008, the first of several solo records he makes alongside the band.

years.src: Wikipedia: Circa Survive · Wikipedia: Anthony Green
years.h: Blue Sky Noise hits No. 11, written in a mental health facility
years.p: Circa Survive's Atlantic debut, made in Toronto with producer [[David Bottrill|1f2f08f6-487d-4bcc-8f9b-41c170b2464f]], reaches No. 11 on the Billboard 200, their highest ever. Many lyrics come from Anthony Green's voluntary three-week stay in a mental health facility.
years.xp:
Wikipedia describes Blue Sky Noise as based on Green's struggles with mental illness. Green has bipolar disorder, which was earlier misdiagnosed as schizophrenia, according to Wikipedia. He has also spent years fighting alcohol and heroin addiction.

[[Rich Costey|d7e7825f-cb30-4c56-a7c8-e0fae10f93f8]] mixed the record, finishing on February 1, 2010. Pre-orders came with a digital copy a week early and the single Get Out.

years.h: Beach Ballyhoo in Santa Monica ends early from overcrowding
years.p: Circa Survive's set at the Pac Sun Beach Ballyhoo in Santa Monica is cut short on June 19, 2010, because too many people showed up.

years.h: 43,000 people watch Circa Survive's London show online
years.p: On a European run with Middle Class Rut, the September 15, 2010 London show is streamed to more than 43,000 viewers.

years.h: The Appendage EP, and a [[Nirvana|5b11f4ce-a62d-471e-81fc-a69a8278c7da]] cover
years.p: Five leftover songs including Stare Like You'll Stay and Lazarus. A MySpace live EP in October adds Nirvana's Scentless Apprentice. They also open two shows for [[Linkin Park|f59c5520-5f46-4d2c-b2c4-822eabf53419]].

eras.title: Going it alone
eras.text: When Atlantic offered less money for the next album, Circa Survive walked and paid for Violent Waves themselves. They kept filling rooms, went to Manila and Coachella, and landed on three different labels in three records.

years.h: Violent Waves, self-released after leaving Atlantic
years.p: Anthony Green said in 2020 that Atlantic offered less money after Blue Sky Noise missed sales targets, so Circa Survive went independent. Recording started April 16, 2012.

years.h: Circa Survive on My Chemical Romance's World Contamination Tour
years.p: The North American leg with My Chemical Romance and Architects, then 33 headline shows with [[Balance and Composure|0d20c42d-133c-429d-8f76-3c2458aee3e8]], [[O'Brother|c6740ace-804e-4d40-aba0-e9c7bfe2cdd2]] and [[Touché Amoré|ea367e3c-4c74-460b-8a99-bbbb9b1ad5cf]].

years.h: Circa Survive play Pulp Summer Slam in Manila
years.p: Circa Survive share a Manila festival bill with [[DragonForce|ef58d4c9-0d40-42ba-bfab-9186c1483edd]], [[Cannibal Corpse|af8e4cc5-ef54-458d-a194-7b210acf638f]], Coheed and Cambria and [[As I Lay Dying|ba147ea0-60c4-4a40-9da6-0d5c2b2e7b03]] on April 27, 2013.

years.h: Circa Survive film a show at the Shrine Expo Hall, LA
years.p: The December 28, 2013 show in Los Angeles is filmed for a DVD packaged with a 2014 Violent Waves reissue.

years.h: A split 7" with Sunny Day Real Estate
years.p: For Record Store Day 2014, Circa Survive share a split single with [[Sunny Day Real Estate|86b24e8f-a4d9-4c84-83ee-fde0d14ad9fa]], the Seattle emo band. Their side is Bad Heart.

q: the most aggressive Circa record we've ever made
years.h: Descensus, recorded with Will Yip, on Sumerian
years.p: Tracked in Conshohocken, Pennsylvania with producer [[Will Yip|282e2957-fd09-4260-babf-50f1d57eeb75]] in spring 2014. Green called it the most aggressive Circa record they'd made.
years.xp: Eleven songs, cut from mid-April to the end of May at Studio 4. Esao Andrews painted the cover again.

years.h: On Letting Go ten-year anniversary tour
years.p: Circa Survive play On Letting Go with [[mewithoutYou|759b5ff1-91fe-4ec9-b9b7-75b7b2ceb283]] and [[Turnover|3a4c8052-7c20-473f-8b41-c3a081cbeb13]] ten years after its release.

years.h: The Amulet, Circa Survive's album for Hopeless
years.p: Their sixth album, announced in July with Lustration. That fall they co-headline with Thrice.

eras.title: Two dreams, then silence
eras.text: Anthony Green went public about a relapse in 2019. The band's last new music was two electronic-leaning EPs, and in October 2022 they stopped.

years.h: Anthony Green goes public about a relapse
years.p: On Twitter, Anthony Green writes that he relapsed and is trying to pull himself back together, calling it the hardest thing he and his family had faced.

years.h: A Dream About Love EP, with Imposter Syndrome
years.p: The first of two EPs that push Circa Survive toward electronics.

years.h: A Dream About Death EP, with Electric Moose
years.p: The companion EP. Green also joins the supergroup [[L.S. Dunes|5bd58bb8-7afc-4664-9b7e-77a687e00137]] with [[Frank Iero|358db9a2-3c78-4afb-93b5-d18b34b86eab]] this year.

years.h: Circa Survive cancel their tour and go on hiatus
years.p: Circa Survive cancel their North American tour and call it an indefinite hiatus, saying their future is uncertain. In December they combine the EPs into the album Two Dreams.

eras.title: It was a breakup, until it wasn't
eras.text: Three years into the hiatus, Anthony Green said what fans suspected. Two months later the band was on a festival poster.

years.h: Anthony Green says the hiatus was really a breakup
years.p: In December 2025 Green admits Circa Survive had broken up, and that it stemmed from his relapse in 2022.

years.h: Circa Survive named to the Louder Than Life 2026 bill
years.p: Louder Than Life in Louisville announces Circa Survive for September, alongside [[Iron Maiden|ca891d65-d9b0-4258-89f7-e6ba29d83767]], My Chemical Romance, [[Tool|66fc5bf8-daa4-4241-b378-9bc9077939d2]] and [[Chiodos|b755836a-0cb6-4577-a678-55a5a6402d70]].

years.h: Circa Survive's first show back, at Louder Than Life
years.p: On September 19, 2026, Circa Survive play Louder Than Life in Louisville, Kentucky, their first show since the 2022 hiatus.
